Review the following terminology related to token quotas:\\\\n\\\\n| Term | Definition |\\\\n| --- | --- |\\\\n| `InputTokenCount` | The CloudWatch Amazon Bedrock runtime metric that represents the number of input tokens processed by the model, excluding cached tokens. To determine your total input token consumption against your quota, sum `InputTokenCount + CacheWriteInputTokenCount`. |\\\\n| `OutputTokenCount` | The CloudWatch Amazon Bedrock runtime metric that represents the number of tokens generated by the model in response to a request. |\\\\n| `CacheReadInputTokenCount` | The CloudWatch Amazon Bedrock runtime metric that represents the number of input tokens that were successfully retrieved from a cache instead of being reprocessed by the model. This value is 0 if you don\\'t use prompt caching. |\\\\n| `CacheWriteInputTokenCount` | The CloudWatch Amazon Bedrock runtime metric that represents the number of input tokens that were successfully written into the cache. This value is 0 if you don\\'t use prompt caching. |\\\\n| Tokens per minute (TPM) | A quota set by AWS at the model level on the number of tokens (including both input and output) that you can use in one minute. |\\\\n| Tokens per day (TPD) | Maximum tokens per day across all supported Amazon Bedrock models for this account. Token count is estimated based on on-demand pricing; actual token consumption varies by model, input/output ratio, and cache usage. |\\\\n| `max_tokens` | A parameter you provide in your request to set a maximum amount of output tokens the model can generate. |\\\\n| Burndown rate | The rate at which input and output tokens are converted into token quota usage for the throttling system. |\\\\n\\\\nThe burndown rate for Anthropic Claude models version 4.8 is **15x for output tokens** (1 output token consumes 15 tokens from your quotas) and the burndown rate for Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5, Claude Opus 5, Claude Fable 5.1, and Claude Fable 5.2 is **10x for output tokens**. The burndown rate for Anthropic Claude Mythos 5, Claude Mythos 5.1, and Claude Mythos 5.2 is **2.5x for output tokens** (1 output token consumes 2.5 tokens from your quotas). For Anthropic Claude Fable 5 and all other Anthropic models version 4.7 and below, the burndown is **5x for output tokens** (1 output token consumes 5 tokens from your quotas).\\\\n\\\\nThe burndown rate for OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.6 Terra, and GPT-5.6 Luna on the `bedrock-runtime` endpoint is **10x for output tokens** (1 output token consumes 10 tokens from your quotas).\\\\n\\\\nUnless otherwise specified in the model card, the burndown rate for all other models is **1:1** (1 output token consumes 1 token from your quota).\\\\n\\\\nToken burndown rates apply only to models available on the `bedrock-runtime` endpoint.
